_why: REPORT-31 M31-0. Each entry binds a parity oracle to the c43 file whose behaviour it reproduces. `frozen` oracles are hand-transliterated and CANNOT see c43 move, so they are gated on a content hash of what they mirror; the endpoint is an empty list, not a maintained one. `generated` oracles are extracted from c43 source and are sound in shape -- they are gated on reproducing byte-identically, because nothing else re-runs the extractor.
_converted: build/tests/flags/flags_oracle.c left this list in M31-2: it now #includes src/c47/flags.c under oracle_* names, so the reference moves with c43 by construction and there is nothing left to hash. Entries leave here by being converted, never by being excused.

frozen.why: 183 lines reproducing the save/restore program framing of saveRestorePrograms.c, including its own PROGRAM_VERSION / OLDEST_COMPATIBLE_PROGRAM_VERSION constants -- so a version bump upstream leaves this lane green.

1060 lines, 43 oracle_* functions -- the largest frozen reference. Reimplements setRegisterDataType, so a widened register tag field changes registers.c, changes nothing here, and the lane agrees with an unported Zig owner.
194 lines against saveRestoreCalcState.c's 2959 -- it mirrors save-file revision parsing and nothing else, while the lane is named for the whole subsystem.
238 lines against keyboard.c's 4982 -- ~4% coverage under a subsystem-wide lane name. Hardest to convert and thinnest coverage, so deliberately last.

generated.why: Extracted from src/c47/charString.c by its own script, so the reference moves with c43 -- but the script's header comment claimed 'the harness fails if the committed oracle is stale' and nothing in the tree re-ran it. Sound shape, ungated until now.
